title: Lord God, Thy Praise We Sing
description: Lord God, Thy Praise We Sing in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Martin Luther, first published in 1529. The English translation is by Richard Massie (1854). The tune, HERR GOTT, DICH LOBEN WIR, is by Martin Luther (1535). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Lord God, Thy praise we sing; Fa-ther in e-ter-ni-ty, An-gels all and heav'n-ly host Both Che-ru-bim and Ser-a-phim Ho-ly art Thou, our God! Ho-ly art Thou, our God, the Lord of Sa-ba-oth!________________ Thee, Fa-ther, on Thy high-est throne, The Com-fort-er, ev'n the Ho-ly Ghost, Thee King of all glo-ry, Christ, we own, To save man-kind Thou hast not, Lord, Thy ser-vants help whom Thou, O God, Grant that we share the heav'n-ly rest Help us, O Lord, from age to age, Nou-rish and keep them by Thy pow'r, Lord God, we praise Thee day by day,________ In Thee, Lord, have we put our trust; A___-men.

lines: Lord God, Thy praise we sing;
Father in eternity,
Angels all and heav'nly host
Both Cherubim and Seraphim Holy art Thou, our God!
Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of
Sabaoth! Thee,
Father, on Thy highest throne,
The Comforter, ev'n the Holy Ghost,
Thee King of all glory,
Christ, we own, To save mankind Thou hast not,
Lord, Thy servants help whom Thou,
O God, Grant that we share the heav'nly rest
Help us, O Lord, from age to age,
Nourish and keep them by Thy pow'r,
Lord God, we praise Thee day by day,
In Thee, Lord, have we put our trust;
Amen.
Lord God, Thy praise we sing;
Father in eternity,
Angels all and heav'nly host
Both Cherubim and Seraphim Holy art Thou, our God!
Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of
Sabaoth! Thee,
Father, on Thy highest throne,
The Comforter, ev'n the Holy Ghost,
Thee King of all glory,
Christ, we own, Thou over camest death's sharp sting,
Thy servants help whom Thou,
O God, Grant that we share the heav'nly rest
Help us, O Lord, from age to age,
Nourish and keep them by Thy pow'r,
Lord God, we praise Thee day by day,
In Thee, Lord, have we put our trust;
Amen.
Lord God, Thy praise we sing;

Both Cherubim and Seraphim Holy art Thou, our God!
Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of
Sabaoth! Thee,
Father, on Thy highest throne,
The Comforter, ev'n the Holy Ghost,
Thee King of all glory,
Christ, we own, At God's right hand Thou sittest, clad Thy servants help whom Thou,
O God, Grant that we share the heav'nly rest
Help us, O Lord, from age to age,
Nourish and keep them by Thy pow'r,
Lord God, we praise Thee day by day,
In Thee, Lord, have we put our trust;
Amen.
Lord God, Thy praise we sing;
Father in eternity,
Angels all and heav'nly host
Both Cherubim and Seraphim Holy art Thou, our God!
Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of
Sabaoth! Thee,
Father, on Thy highest throne,
The Comforter, ev'n the Holy Ghost,
Thee King of all glory,
Christ, we own, Thou shalt in glory come again,
Thy servants help whom Thou,
O God, Grant that we share the heav'nly rest
Help us, O Lord, from age to age,
Nourish and keep them by Thy pow'r,
Lord God, we praise Thee day by day,
In Thee, Lord, have we put our trust;
Amen.
